points.evidence: The claim is false. "Battle for Haditha" (2007) is a film by Nick Broomfield and is a follow-up to his earlier film "Ghosts," not to a documentary titled "ערס." The slang term "ערס" (Ars) is a derogatory Hebrew term for a low-class young man of Middle Eastern Jewish origin, not for European ethnicities. There is no evidence linking the film's title to any slang term for Europeans.
